metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve neck and shoulder pain.

These exercises are going to focus on the main muscles that cause pain in this area, including the levator scapulae and the upper trapezius. 

Each exercise works a little differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief. 

Let us know what works for you! 

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:47 Upper Trapezius Stretch
3:36 Levator Scapulae Stretch
5:22 Strengthening Exercise 1
7:12 Strengthening Exercise 2
